description: This file defines the SmartyBC class, a backward compatibility wrapper for the Smarty template engine, providing legacy methods and extended functionality while inheriting from the main Smarty class.

classes.name: SmartyBC
classes.description: A backward compatibility wrapper class for Smarty, providing legacy method interfaces and additional utility functions for the Smarty PHP template engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SmartyBC object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: assign_by_ref
methods.description: Wrapper for assignByRef, assigns a reference to a template variable.

methods.name: append_by_ref
methods.description: Wrapper for appendByRef, appends a reference to a template variable.

methods.name: clear_assign
methods.description: Clears the given assigned template variable.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a custom function to be used in templates.

methods.name: register_object
methods.description: Registers an object to be used in templates with optional allowed methods and argument format.

methods.name: register_block
methods.description: Registers a block function for templates.

methods.name: unregister_block
methods.description: Unregisters a block function from templates.

methods.name: register_compiler_function
methods.description: Registers a compiler function in templates.

methods.name: register_modifier
methods.description: Registers a modifier for use in templates.

methods.name: register_resource
methods.description: Registers a resource type for templates.

methods.name: register_prefilter
methods.description: Registers a prefilter function for templates.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific template and cache id.

methods.name: is_cached
methods.description: Checks if valid cache exists for a template.

methods.name: clear_compiled_tpl
methods.description: Clears compiled version of a template.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration values from a file.

methods.name: get_registered_object
methods.description: Returns a reference to a registered object.
